1.mascotDialogue: Nothing fancy here, cara — compare your neighbor, swap if you are bigger, and repeat the whole sweep until nothing needs swapping anymore!

2.mascotDialogue: `n minus i minus 1` on line 3 shrinks the inner loop's range with every pass — the last i elements are already sorted, no need to keep checking them again!

3.mascotDialogue: Watch the tallest bar creep one step right with every swap she loses — this is the 'bubbling' the algorithm is named for, made completely literal.

4.mascotDialogue: This one will not crash every time — she will simply, occasionally, read garbage past the array! Exactly the sort of bug that slips by unnoticed, because she does not always announce herself.
